record.problem: keeping the area free of visitors that can get hurt

scenarios.question1: What should be done immediately if a landslide occurs on a forest road to prevent visitors from entering the hazardous area?
scenarios.question2: A few days after a landslide on a forest road, what steps should be taken to continue keeping the area secure from visitors?
scenarios.question3: Several weeks following a landslide on a forest road, what long-term measures can be implemented to maintain safety and prevent access?

scenarios.question1: What immediate actions should be taken to secure a forest road if a sinkhole appears?
scenarios.question2: What actions are essential a week after a sinkhole has formed on a forest road to ensure the area remains isolated?
scenarios.question3: What are the permanent solutions to consider a few weeks after a sinkhole event on a forest road to keep visitors safe?

record.solution1: have fire department set up a barricade
record.solution2: putting up caution flags warning signs and keep out signs
record.solution3: contacting contractors to build a retaining wall at the bottom
record.explanation1: this keeps people out while getting the caution and warning tape
record.explanation2: more of solution instead of having someone posted at the location
